name: I Want To Make Something Beautiful
source:
A short game about an artist who wants desperately to create, but fears they can produce nothing of value.

[Edited from [url=https://pixeldotgamer.itch.io/i-want-to-make-something-beautiful]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于一位艺术家的短游戏，他渴望创作，但担心自己无法创造出任何有价值的东西。

[编辑自[url=https://pixeldotgamer.itch.io/i-want-to-make-something-beautiful]itch.io[/url]]
